projects.name: StackRadar
projects.positioning: An AI-powered solution designed to reduce manual effort in a real job-search workflow.
verifiedFacts: It uses LLMs to streamline repetitive parts of the job-search workflow.
It helps job seekers quickly screen newly posted roles for suitability and assists with cover letter drafting.
In Junwen's personal use, it reduced the time required for job screening and cover letter drafting by around 80%.

projects.name: Automated Nematode Egg Detection
projects.positioning: A computer-vision solution designed to reduce manual effort in a real laboratory egg-counting workflow.
verifiedFacts: Junwen developed and delivered a proof-of-concept web prototype that uses computer vision to automate part of a manual laboratory egg-counting workflow.
The solution keeps laboratory technicians in the review loop.
